note: The five stances and what the four face buttons do in each (docs/design/melee-press-feel.md section 10; Orb's stance layout in docs/ep/vision.md). The stance is what the player holds: nothing is martial arts, LB defensive, RB energy arts, RT charging, LT manoeuvre (the intent's stanceMask: LB 1, RB 2, RT 4, LT 8). `name` is the word on the plate's badge, `title` the full name, `cells` the face buttons X (quick), Y (strong), A (context) and B (signature), each as a short name. The words are a first draft for Narrative to edit; the player is the fighter, so they name what you do. Hybrids (LT+RB, LB+RB, LT+LB) are reserved and not in this file: a held pair reads as its newer button. Costs are not here: they are Game Design's data (the zip strike is 20 ki, by Orb's ruling).
